summary: Section B of the TICO Statistical Plan establishes coding rules for premiums and losses, including statistical plan/state identifiers, line of business, policy forms, occupancy, construction, roof, PPC, deductible, loss type, cause of loss, prior claims, TWIA credits, law and ordinance coverage, optional credits/endorsements, and rating-variable usage. The section is primarily composed of code tables, with important prose rules for TICO approval of vacant-occupancy code 7, construction predominance, roof-credit standards, deductible-code selection, proximate cause-of-loss coding, ZIP reporting, and rating-variable usage reporting.

proposed_nodes.title: TICO Stat Plan — Section B: Coding for Premiums and Losses

proposed_nodes.name: Texas Insurance Checking Office (TICO)
proposed_nodes.notes: Referenced in the section title and in the approval note for Coverage-Occupancy Code 7.

proposed_nodes.name: Texas Department of Insurance (TDI)
proposed_nodes.notes: Referenced as approving alternative roof-covering standards for roof credits.

proposed_nodes.name: Insurance Services Office (ISO)
proposed_nodes.notes: Referenced in approved policy forms and Public Protection Class coding.

proposed_nodes.name: American Association of Insurance Services (AAIS)
proposed_nodes.notes: Referenced in the Other Approved Forms table.

proposed_nodes.name: Texas Windstorm Insurance Association (TWIA)
proposed_nodes.notes: Referenced in TWIA wind-only line of business, TWIA-only surcharges, and TWIA-only building-code credits.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule B.5 — Policy Forms
proposed_nodes.title: Policy Forms
proposed_nodes.notes: Includes Homeowners/Dwellings form codes and Other Approved Forms for all lines of business.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule B.7 — Coverage–Occupancy
proposed_nodes.title: Coverage – Occupancy
proposed_nodes.notes: Includes a TICO approval condition before using vacant-occupancy Code 7.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule B.8 — Construction
proposed_nodes.title: Construction
proposed_nodes.notes: Defines construction classifications and predominant-construction treatment for mixed construction risks.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule B.8A — Roof Construction
proposed_nodes.title: Roof Construction
proposed_nodes.notes: Excludes tenants and condominium; includes roof covering, roof credit, and roof-year reporting guidance.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule B.8B — Exclusion of Cosmetic Damage to Roof Coverings Endorsement
proposed_nodes.title: Exclusion of Cosmetic Damage to Roof Coverings Endorsement
proposed_nodes.notes: Provides two codes indicating whether the endorsement is attached.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule B.9 — Protection ISO Public Protection Class (PPC)
proposed_nodes.title: Protection ISO Public Protection Class (PPC)
proposed_nodes.notes: Directs reporting ISO PPC if used in rating and maps PPC 10 and 8B to legacy one-character codes.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule B.9A — Protection ISO Public Protection Class, Including New Split Classifications
proposed_nodes.title: Protection ISO Public Protection Class, Including New Split Classifications

proposed_nodes.name: Rule B.10 — Deductible Type or Amount
proposed_nodes.title: Deductible Type or Amount
proposed_nodes.notes: Defines deductible codes for Homeowners and Dwellings, plus selection rules when multiple deductibles or perils apply.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule B.11 — Type of Loss Code
proposed_nodes.title: Type of Loss Code
proposed_nodes.notes: Includes note for watercraft losses under the basic policy.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule B.12 — Cause of Loss Codes
proposed_nodes.title: Cause of Loss Codes
proposed_nodes.notes: Requires coding by original and proximate cause, not ensuing causes, and gives tornado/rain and freeze/pipe examples.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule B.14 — ZIP Code
proposed_nodes.title: ZIP Code
proposed_nodes.notes: Requires five-digit ZIP code of each risk and ZIP+4 if available.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule B.15 — Building Code Credits (TWIA Only)
proposed_nodes.title: Building Code Credits (TWIA Only)
proposed_nodes.notes: Applies to TWIA building-code credit codes.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule B.16 — Law and Ordinance Coverage
proposed_nodes.title: Law and Ordinance Coverage

proposed_nodes.name: Rule B.17 — Optional Credit — Personal Property ID (HO)
proposed_nodes.title: Optional Credit – Personal Property ID (HO)

proposed_nodes.name: Rule B.18 — Optional Coverage Endorsements
proposed_nodes.title: Optional Coverage Endorsements
proposed_nodes.notes: Requires reporting actual endorsement number, excluding dashes, for endorsements providing mold, water, foundation, or flood coverage; additional records may be used as necessary.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule B.19 — Amount of Coverage for Optional Coverage Endorsement
proposed_nodes.title: Amount of Coverage for Optional Coverage Endorsement
proposed_nodes.notes: Requires percent or dollar amount, as applicable, for optional coverage endorsement.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule B.20 — Use of Certain Rating Variables
proposed_nodes.title: Use of Certain Rating Variables
proposed_nodes.notes: Requires insurers to report how specified rating/tiering variables are used and provides one-digit usage codes.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Statistical Plan
proposed_nodes.description: Statistical plan code table; Residential Risk – Dwellings – Homeowners (HO) is coded as 4.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — State Code
proposed_nodes.description: State code table; Texas is coded as 42.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Kind Codes — Losses
proposed_nodes.description: Loss kind codes distinguish no-current-payment/outstanding records, reopened paid-loss records, non-reopened paid-loss records, and outstanding-loss records by prior closed-with-payment status.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Line of Business
proposed_nodes.description: Line-of-business code table for homeowners tenants/condominium owners, homeowners excluding tenants, dwelling fire/property/time element, liability, wind-only, theft, extended coverages, private flood, supplemental natural disaster protection, and TWIA surcharges.
proposed_nodes.notes: Includes TWIA wind-only and TWIA-only surcharge codes.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Policy Forms
proposed_nodes.description: Policy-form code table for homeowners, dwellings, and other approved forms across all lines of business, including independent, ISO, and AAIS forms.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Number of Families
proposed_nodes.description: Number-of-families code table for homeowners and dwellings, including one-or-two-family, dwelling-only, personal-property-only, tenants forms with/without optional theft deductible, and dwelling/personal-property combinations.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Coverage–Occupancy
proposed_nodes.description: Coverage-occupancy code table for homeowners and dwelling fire/extended coverage, including owner/tenant occupancy, vacant occupancy, liability-only, and small mercantile occupancy distinctions.
proposed_nodes.notes: Code 7 requires prior TICO approval before use.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Construction
proposed_nodes.description: Construction classification code list for homeowners, dwelling fire, and allied lines, with definitions for frame, stucco, brick veneer, brick, semi fire resistive, and fire resistive construction, plus mixed-construction predominance rules.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Roof Covering
proposed_nodes.description: Roof-covering code list for the predominant type of roof covering, including composition shingle, wood, aluminum, steel, copper, roll roofing, tar and gravel, tile, slate, fiber cement/concrete, plastic, recycled products, single-ply membrane, other, metal type unknown, and unknown/not used in rating.
proposed_nodes.notes: Applies under Rule B.8A and excludes tenants and condominium.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Roof Credit
proposed_nodes.description: Roof-credit code list for no credit or Class 1 through Class 4 credit; credits are reported only for roof coverings meeting UL2218 or other TDI-approved standards.
proposed_nodes.notes: Policies not eligible for Class 1, 2, 3, or 4 credit should be reported as 0.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Exclusion of Cosmetic Damage to Roof Coverings Endorsement
proposed_nodes.description: Two-value code list indicating whether the exclusion of cosmetic damage to roof coverings endorsement is attached to the policy.
proposed_nodes.code_list_name: Exclusion of Cosmetic Damage to Roof Coverings Endorsement
proposed_nodes.notes: 0 = endorsement not attached; 1 = endorsement attached.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Protection ISO Public Protection Class (PPC)
proposed_nodes.description: Legacy PPC code list for reporting ISO Public Protection Class if used in rating; includes codes 1-9, A, and B, with A for PPC 10 and B for PPC 8B.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Protection ISO Public Protection Class, Including New Split Classifications
proposed_nodes.description: PPC code list for new split classifications, using two-character codes such as 01, 02, 03, 10, 12, 13, 19, 20, and related split-class codes through 83.
proposed_nodes.code_list_name: Protection ISO Public Protection Class, Including New Split Classifications

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Deductible Type or Amount
proposed_nodes.description: Deductible code list for homeowners and dwellings, including full coverage, fixed-dollar deductibles, percentage deductibles, no wind coverage, and greater-than-10-percent deductibles.
proposed_nodes.notes: Includes seacoast-territory treatment for Code 1 and wind-exclusion territory restrictions for Code 7.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Type of Loss Code
proposed_nodes.description: Type-of-loss code list for homeowners losses under Section I, Section II, enhancement endorsements, and other additional premium-paying endorsements.
proposed_nodes.notes: Watercraft losses covered under the basic policy are reported as 1 when horsepower/length thresholds in the note are met.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Cause of Loss
proposed_nodes.description: Cause-of-loss code list for homeowners and dwellings, including fire by source, lightning, windstorm, hail, flood/rising water, explosion, smoke, aircraft/vehicles, riot/civil commotion, vandalism/malicious mischief, collapse, water/steam discharge, freeze, theft, other physical damage, and liability/medical payments.
proposed_nodes.notes: Cause of Loss should reflect the original and proximate cause, not ensuing causes.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Prior Claims History
proposed_nodes.description: Prior-claims-history code list for number of chargeable claims in the last five years, plus code for companies that do not use prior claims history in rating or tiering.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Building Code Credits (TWIA Only)
proposed_nodes.description: TWIA-only building-code credit code list for seaward, Inland I, and Inland II new/retrofitted structures and not-applicable status.
proposed_nodes.notes: Limited to TWIA according to the table heading.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Law and Ordinance Coverage
proposed_nodes.description: Law-and-ordinance coverage code list for no additional coverage, 10%, 15%, 25%, and other approved limits purchased.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Optional Credit — Personal Property ID (HO)
proposed_nodes.description: Homeowners optional personal-property-ID credit code list indicating whether the optional credit applies.
proposed_nodes.notes: 0 = credit does not apply; 1 = credit applies.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Use of Certain Rating Variables
proposed_nodes.description: One-digit code list for how specified variables are used in rating or tiering: used with no factor, discount/factor under 1.000, surcharge/factor over 1.000, used for tier placement without specific factor, or not used.
proposed_nodes.notes: Variables include alarms, age of home, sprinklers, loss/claims experience, companion policies, credit-based insurance score, senior citizen, smart/connected home, new/recently purchased home, and specified additional risk surcharges.

proposed_nodes.name: EndorsementRule — Exclusion of Cosmetic Damage to Roof Coverings Endorsement
proposed_nodes.form_name: Exclusion of Cosmetic Damage to Roof Coverings Endorsement
proposed_nodes.coverage_effect: Excludes cosmetic damage to roof coverings when the endorsement is attached; coding indicates attached/not attached.

proposed_nodes.name: EndorsementRule — Wind Exclusion Endorsement
proposed_nodes.coverage_effect: Subject endorsement for Deductible Code 7 no-wind-coverage treatment in specified territories and catastrophe-area portions of named municipalities.

proposed_nodes.name: EndorsementRule — Optional Coverage Endorsements for Mold, Water, Foundation, or Flood
proposed_nodes.notes: Examples given include HO161, HO162, TDP004, and TDP005.
proposed_nodes.coverage_effect: Provides coverage for mold, water, foundation, or flood; actual endorsement number excluding dashes must be reported.

proposed_nodes.name: Coverage–Occupancy Code 7 — All policies with vacant occupancy
proposed_nodes.description: All policies with vacant occupancy
proposed_nodes.notes: Before using Code 7, an insurer must receive approval from TICO.

proposed_nodes.name: Deductible Code 7 — No Wind Coverage
proposed_nodes.description: No Wind Coverage
proposed_nodes.notes: Applies in Territories 8, 9, and 10, and specified catastrophe-area portions of La Porte, Morgan's Point, Pasadena, Seabrook, and Shore Acres in Territory 1, subject to Wind Exclusion Endorsement.

proposed_nodes.name: Cause of Loss Code 25 — Windstorm
proposed_nodes.description: Windstorm
proposed_nodes.notes: Cause should reflect original and proximate cause; tornado/rain example is reported as windstorm, not water damage.

proposed_nodes.name: Cause of Loss Code 30 — Hail
proposed_nodes.description: Hail
proposed_nodes.notes: Listed as a homeowners and dwellings cause-of-loss code.

proposed_nodes.name: Cause of Loss Code 32 — Flood or Rising Water
proposed_nodes.description: Flood or Rising Water
proposed_nodes.notes: Listed as a homeowners and dwellings cause-of-loss code.
